steps.en: Stand up the Standalone container next to a Valkey store
steps.zh: 起 Standalone 容器，配一个 Valkey 存储

steps.en: Open the dashboard, log in with ADMIN_KEY, create a site key
steps.zh: 打开面板，用 ADMIN_KEY 登录，创建一个 site key

steps.en: Issues SHA-256 proof-of-work challenges bound to that site key
steps.zh: 按这个 site key 签发 SHA-256 工作量证明挑战

steps.en: Drop the widget into the form you want to protect
steps.zh: 把 widget 放进要保护的表单

steps.en: The visitor's browser solves in parallel WASM workers and yields a single-use token
steps.zh: 访客浏览器在并行 WASM worker 里解题，产出一个单次 token

steps.en: Before trusting the submission, POST the token to your /siteverify endpoint
steps.zh: 处理提交前，把 token POST 到你的 /siteverify 接口

value.en: Bots pay CPU per action and humans click one checkbox, while verification never leaves your infrastructure
value.zh: 机器人每个动作都要付 CPU，真人只点一次勾选框，校验全程留在你自己的基础设施里
